findings.title: Character Creator native import handle is parsed as JSON
findings.impact: Native JSON and PNG imports cannot open as Character Creator drafts.
findings.required_fix: Add sender-bound one-time handle consumption IPC returning a bounded V2 DTO and managed avatar reference.

findings.title: Character Creator autosave suppresses write failure
findings.impact: Edits can be lost while validation, export or approval proceeds.
findings.required_fix: Retain pending data until success, return typed failure, block approval/export, and add revision-safe serialization.

findings.title: Completion documentation contradicts live status
findings.impact: Release and agent decisions can rely on false completion claims.
findings.required_fix: Reopen the roadmap item, correct reports, and add a cross-ledger consistency verifier.

findings.title: Character Creator IPC channel map contains unregistered operations
findings.impact: Trusted API contract drifts from implementation.
findings.required_fix: Remove dead channels or implement every channel through typed main/preload/renderer contracts.

findings.title: Character Creator validation IPC is weaker than canonical approval validation
findings.impact: Malformed cards can pass the main-process validator.
findings.required_fix: Use one shared runtime schema and canonical validator.

findings.title: Character Creator export trusts unbounded renderer DTO and data URL
findings.required_fix: Export by canonical draft/card ID or strictly validate and bound decoded data.

findings.title: AI Design Process is largely post-hoc and hardcodes original mode
findings.impact: Displayed process and inspiration mode do not match documented semantics.
findings.required_fix: Implement real concept-analysis stage or rename the UI; preserve all design modes.

findings.title: Character Creator response validation is incomplete
findings.impact: Unbounded arrays, unsafe extension keys, silent truncation and raw errors can pass.
findings.required_fix: Use recursive JSON validation, limits, warnings and centralized redaction.

findings.title: Document Agent release hardening is incomplete
findings.impact: Source retention, parser isolation, full review UI, tool-loop integration, journal recovery and packaged QA are missing.
findings.required_fix: Complete the canonical roadmap acceptance scope.

findings.title: Direct source-image reverse matching is not implemented
findings.impact: Image Inspector cannot perform true source-image web matching.
findings.required_fix: Select a provider and implement consent, custody, upload, normalization, cost and tests.

findings.title: Signed, paid, two-device and accessibility release evidence is missing
findings.required_fix: Run the complete signed and manual acceptance matrix.

findings.title: Advanced sync providers and live key rotation are deferred
findings.required_fix: Implement only if retained in release scope; otherwise clearly defer.

findings.title: Orphan archival is dry-run-only
findings.impact: Users can analyze but not safely repair orphan records.
findings.required_fix: Add quarantine, preview, rollback and audit.

findings.title: Six provider families are not implemented
findings.required_fix: Implement or remove from near-term feature claims.

findings.title: Scheduled credential rotation is not implemented
findings.required_fix: Implement only with provider-specific secure custody and audit.

findings.title: Jina respectRobotsTxt control is not implemented
findings.impact: A requested policy control cannot be claimed as effective.
findings.required_fix: Verify provider support or remove/disable the option.

findings.title: Provider verifier mock portability debt
findings.required_fix: Move Electron mock setup to the shared test setup.

findings.title: Deprecated enhancePrompt extraction no-op
findings.required_fix: Remove or correctly map the deprecated fallthrough.
